question: Which sport term is not associated with Cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sprint**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "sprint" is not associated with cricket:
 
 
• "Sprint" is a term associated with cycling, while terms
 
 
• like "toss", "run", "wicket", "pitch", "crease", "pavilion", "wicket keeper", "over", "maiden over", "follow-on", "ashes", "catch", "bowled", "stump out", "run out", "L.B.W", "hit wicket", "not out", "no ball", "wide ball", "dead ball", "overthrow", "bye", "leg bye", and "cover drive" are associated with cricket
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hattrick:**

 
 
• **​** A term used in sports, especially cricket, to describe a bowler taking three wickets in three consecutive deliveries.
 
 
 
• **Crease:**
 
 
• A marked line on the pitch in cricket, where the batsman stands to receive the ball.
 
 
 
• **Follow-through**
 
 
• It is a term used in various contexts, but most commonly in sports and project management
 
• It refers to the completion of a motion, such as a golf swing or a tennis stroke, after the ball has been hit.
 
• It's essential for accuracy, power, and control in many sports.
